summary: The document provides structure and functionality for the 'Upload Templates' page within HSPnet. It includes UI components, event handling, data binding, and validation for managing template uploads.
purpose: To facilitate uploading and managing templates through a web interface within HSPnet.

workflows.name: Template Management
steps: Page Load: Initialize template management page and dropdowns.
Agency Change: Update department dropdown and refresh data.
Department Change: Refresh data based on selected department.
Add Template: Switch to add mode and show details view.
Edit Template: Fetch and populate details for editing.
Delete Template: Remove selected template and refresh data.
Save Template: Validate and save template details.

business_rules: Templates are hard-coded to the Excel format.
Header Rows must be greater than zero.

validations.validation: Must be an integer greater than zero.
validations.message: HeaderRows must be a number greater than zero.

system_behavior: GridView and DetailsView are used for data presentation and manipulation.
ModalPopupExtender is used for displaying detail views as pop-ups.
